reviews.comment:
La infladora para las llantas esta rota, nadie nos aviso. El pico esta fallado, o se rompio, una de dos. Estuvimos 15m intentando inflar, no habia ni un cartel ni nadie nos aviso, en un momento me di cuenta que en vez de inflar estaba desinflando. Tuve que cambiar la llanta por la de auxilio, no hay una sola gomeria abierta en fin de semana. Uno de los playeros se acerco a ayudar, fue un divino, pero no puede ser que sepan que esta roto y ni te avisen. Me desinflo entera la llanta, que inviable todo.

(Translated by Google)
The tire inflator was broken, and nobody warned us. The nozzle was faulty, or it broke, one of the two. We spent 15 minutes trying to inflate the tire; there wasn't a single sign, and nobody told us. At one point, I realized that instead of inflating, it was deflating. I had to switch to the spare tire; there isn't a single tire shop open on the weekend. One of the gas station attendants came to help; he was a sweetheart, but it's unacceptable that they know it's broken and don't even warn you. My tire completely went flat; the whole thing was a disaster.
